page_title: Xmind - Mind Map Maker & AI Brainstorming Tool

sources.entry: XMind - The most popular mind-mapping tool on the planet.

summary.name: XMind
summary.one_liner: XMind is a mind-mapping and brainstorming tool, available on the web, desktop and mobile, with an AI assistant (Xmind Agent) for building and expanding mind maps.
use_cases: planning projects and breaking goals into tasks
building a mind map from a document or conversation
summary.what_it_does:
Xmind lets users create mind maps online or in desktop apps, and the page describes it as working on web, desktop, and mobile. Xmind Agent can build a structured map from a sentence, file, link, or conversation, and it can expand or reshape the map through chat. The page also mentions structure types such as mind maps, timelines, matrices, and Zones, plus an enhanced Gantt chart with working-day planning that can be exported or printed. Real-time collaboration, shared team spaces, and cross-device sync are listed, along with modes for free brainstorming, presenting, and focused ZEN work.</what_it_does>
